parts.html: The K-41 kitchen model combines a contemporary straight-line layout with dark graphite upper cabinets and light lower cabinetry. The upper fronts feature a subtle wood texture that gives the dark finish depth, while the lower cabinets, tall side units, and the open niche on the right of the upper row share the same light, off-white shade.

The defining visual feature of K-41 is its carefully balanced contrast. The dark upper cabinets establish a strong horizontal line, while the light lower and tall cabinets make the overall composition feel less visually heavy.

The open niche on the right repeats the finish of the lower cabinets and tall side units. It is light-colored rather than having a separate wood-effect finish. This coordinated treatment connects the different sections of the kitchen and softens the transition between dark and light cabinetry.

A dark countertop with a black marble-effect pattern brings the two contrasting sections together. Light veining on the worktop echoes the light fronts and backsplash, giving the kitchen a coherent appearance.
The design suits contemporary apartments and private residences, including open-plan kitchen-living spaces where the furniture forms part of the wider interior composition.
Layout and dimensions

K-41 has a linear length of 4.2 meters. Its straight-line configuration arranges the main furniture along one wall. Upper and lower cabinets, tall side units, working surfaces, and spaces for built-in appliances form one continuous functional composition.
The standard dimensions are 4.2 × 2.4 × 0.6 m.

In the supplied visualization, a built-in oven is positioned within a tall light-colored unit on the left. The central section contains the main worktop, cooking area, and sink. A tall light-colored unit completes the arrangement on the right, while the open niche in the upper row provides space for tableware and frequently used items.
During individual planning, the appliance layout, sink position, cabinet arrangement, and working areas can be adapted to the room dimensions and existing service connections.
A separate kitchen island is not included in the standard K-41 configuration.
Materials and finishes

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are made from laminated particleboard, but have different decorative finishes. The closed upper cabinets are very dark graphite with a subtle wood texture, while the lower cabinets and tall side units have a solid light finish.

The open niche on the right of the upper row has the same light finish as the lower cabinets and tall side units. It provides a visual connection between the different sections and maintains the consistent color scheme of the kitchen.
The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.

The countertop is chipboard-based, with a dark black marble-effect decorative finish. Light veining gives the surface its stone-inspired appearance. Natural marble is not specified as the material of the standard worktop.
The light backsplash complements the lower cabinetry, while the black tap and built-in oven reinforce the darker details of the design.
Functionality and standard hardware

K-41 is designed to accommodate built-in household appliances. The final appliance selection and positioning are determined during individual planning. Built-in appliance compatibility does not automatically mean the appliances themselves are included in the standard furniture price.
A pull-out cargo storage system is included as standard, providing additional accessible storage for food and kitchen essentials.
Hinged cabinet doors use Hettich hinges with soft-close. Pull-out elements are fitted with Quadro Hettich concealed runners.

The concealed runners are mounted beneath the pull-out elements, helping maintain a clean appearance inside the cabinetry. The original specification does not separately confirm soft-close for the Quadro runners, so it is not presented as an included feature.
Cabinet handles are included. Lift mechanisms are not part of the standard specification.

K-41 can be customized beyond its standard hardware and materials. Upon request, clients can choose more functional furniture fittings, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional storage systems. Alternative materials are also available, ranging from budget-friendly options to premium finishes.
These options are selected separately according to individual preferences, room requirements, and project budget. They are not part of the stated standard configuration.
K-41 Kitchen Specifications — Standard Configuration
Color: Grey; dark graphite upper cabinetry and light lower cabinets in the visualization.
Style: Contemporary.
Configuration: Straight-line / single-wall kitchen.
Countertop: Chipboard-based.
Countertop finish: Dark black marble-effect.
Dimensions: 4.2 × 2.4 × 0.6 m.
Lift mechanism: None.
Appliances: Designed for built-in appliances.
Cargo storage: Yes.
Handles: Included.
Upper cabinet fronts: Laminated particleboard with dark graphite wood-textured finish.
Lower cabinet fronts: Laminated particleboard with solid light finish.
Cabinet construction: 18 mm laminated particleboard.
Linear length: 4.2 m.
Kitchen island: No.
Hinges: Hettich with soft-close.
Finish: Mixed — dark graphite upper cabinets and light lower fronts.
Drawer runners: Quadro Hettich concealed runners.

Additional visible design features: Tall side units and the open niche on the right of the upper row match the light lower cabinetry; light backsplash, dark marble-effect countertop, and a built-in oven on the left.
Custom K-41 kitchens in Bratislava and Vienna
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-41 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, with adjustments to the cabinet run, built-in appliance positions, cabinet arrangement, and storage systems. Clients can select alternative graphite and light front colors, countertop and cabinet materials, and additional hardware.

Our services include kitchen planning, material and hardware selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and household appliances can also be selected upon request.
